<!--
The easiest way to submit is the "Submit to the leaderboard" button on
https://aifitnessapi.com/tools/pose-benchmark after a run: it opens this
issue with the block below already filled in from your run.

If you start here instead, run the benchmark, then paste the page's result
block between the fences below. Please do not type numbers by hand: the
leaderboard only imports blocks the page produced.

A maintainer checks each submission and adds the `pose-benchmark:accepted`
label; scripts/import-pose-benchmark-results.mjs imports only those.
Everything here is public, including the user agent and GPU name your
browser reported. Remove anything you do not want published before you
submit.
-->

Device model and notes (optional: power mode, other tabs, thermal state):


```json pose-benchmark-result
```
